note: diagnostic path (R-scale direct final stage, fixed-branch Ipopt restoration); not the 900-run measurement and not a reproduction of the paper

indicator_definitions.final_common_kkt: final smoothed AL point, common scale, max KKT <= 1e-6
indicator_definitions.final_both_scales_kkt: same final AL point, also physical-variable scale <= 1e-6
indicator_definitions.last_restoration_solver_accepted: the last fixed-branch Ipopt restoration was accepted
indicator_definitions.physical_point_available: a returnable original-feasible point exists (original residual <= 1e-6, battery strictly in [0,1], assigned stamps and modes)
indicator_definitions.selected_same_final_branch_kkt: fixed-branch KKT <= 1e-6 at the returned point; km-scaled measure of fixed_branch.py with a 1e-8 battery margin, a different measure from the two AL KKT columns
indicator_definitions.both_scales_kkt_and_final_certificate: conjunction of two different points: smoothed KKT at the final AL point (not original-feasible) and the fixed-branch certificate at the returned point

regression_unchanged.note: all seen before; includes the 4 R2f holdout inputs (seeds 101, 103, 105, 107), which are not independent here; replay only, no solve

design_case.note: the retention rule was designed on this case (PLAN.md:27)
design_case.returned_point_satisfies_smoothed_kkt: not evaluated and not implied; the smoothed KKT holds at the final AL point, the certificate at the returned point

negative_battery_cohort.note: inputs selected because the initial battery is negative; counts, not a population rate

final_al_point_versus_returned_point.note: the returned point is never the final AL point: it is the output of the fixed-branch restoration, or for the design case the re-evaluated initialization point; the conjunction column therefore joins judgments about two points in every evaluation

plan28_supplement.plan_line: PLAN.md:28 asks for reason/reference/hash of the unaccepted R2f result in the adopted result
plan28_supplement.saved_reason_is_misleading: not_available is the initial value in retain.py; the restoration was attempted and not accepted
plan28_supplement.reason: solver flag or fixed-branch KKT of the returned point

screening.rule: first two negative-battery inputs per fixed seed range
screening.negative_frequency_not_estimable: the scan stops at the second negative-battery input of each range, so 4 of 8 is produced by the stopping rule

design_case.source: re-evaluated initialization NLP point (preprocessing), not a result of the final AL

this_run.note: wall-clock of driver.py; the 21 regression jobs only replay saved results

construction.note: guard.json seconds covers the audit of the original input and the construction together

unitemized_in_phase_steps.note: process start, model build, preflight, existing verifier and file output; no separate record

not_recorded: existing verifier and preflight inside each phase step

reused_past_not_in_this_wall_clock.note: read from the reused sources; not added to this run

post_run_verification.note: this verification, separate from the solve cost; script-internal times

input_relations.not_checked: the 4 audited but unselected inputs (tau5 seeds 200, 201, 202, 204) were not saved as input files

added.note: not part of the existing verifier; recomputed from saved states in reverify.py

rust.note: 1e-6 is counted from the printed Rust values (3 significant digits); smoothed AL points are not original-feasible and have no strict check

unit_test.note: the tests are built on the tau5-seed3 data (the design case); not an independent validation

last_restoration.reason: solver flag or fixed-branch KKT of the returned point
